title: Kronecker Symbol Fix and Mathlib Gap (OQ-03-OQ-01-OQ-01-OQ-04)
description: Documents the Mathlib gap (no Kronecker symbol, only Jacobi for odd moduli). Provides corrected kroneckerTwoFixed using a % 8 = 7 instead of a % 8 = -1. Verifies against Mathlib's χ₈ and proves full multiplicativity of the corrected definition. 11 theorems, 0 sorries, 0 axioms.

overview.historicalContext: The Kronecker symbol extends the Jacobi symbol to all integers. Mathlib 4.26.0 has jacobiSym for odd moduli but no Kronecker symbol. The gallery's kroneckerSym has a correctness issue for a ≡ 7 (mod 8).
overview.problemStatement: Document the Mathlib gap, fix kroneckerTwo to correctly handle a ≡ 7 (mod 8), and verify multiplicativity.
overview.proofStrategy: The bug: T-div mod gives (7:ℤ) % 8 = 7 ≠ -1, so the gallery's check a % 8 = -1 gives kroneckerTwo 7 = -1 but correct value is 1. Fix: check a % 8 = 7 instead. Multiplicativity proved case by case.
keyInsights: **T-div vs Euclidean division**: in Lean, integers use truncated division mod, so (-1:ℤ) % 8 = -1 but 7 % 8 = 7 ≠ -1. The original code assumed Euclidean mod.
**Mathlib gap**: jacobiSym covers odd moduli; the Kronecker symbol for modulus 2 requires special handling of the cases a ≡ ±1 (mod 8) vs a ≡ ±3 (mod 8).
**χ₈ comparison**: Mathlib's character χ₈: ZMod 8 → ℤ provides ground truth for the corrected Kronecker(2) values.
